## What's changed

- Preserved each scheduled item's native frame cadence in the Apple TV Tube TV HLS stream instead of forcing all programming to 29.97 fps.
- Removed the repeating cadence judder that can appear when 23.976 fps films are converted to 29.97 fps.
- Kept the existing resolution normalization, HDR handling, continuous channel timeline, and HLS discontinuities between programs, commercials, and bumpers.
- Left local-library, Discovery, Steam, and retro-player playback paths unchanged.
